name: esxiargs
recommendedActions: Monitor for VM file encryption activities
campaignsText: Campaign targeted unpatched VMware servers globally, primarily in Europe. Notable operation in February 2023 with significant impact.
description: ESXiArgs is a ransomware campaign targeting VMware ESXi servers via CVE-2021-21974. It encrypts virtual machine files, rendering them inaccessible and demanding payment for decryption. Thousands of European organizations were affected, with CISA and FBI releasing a decryptor.
goals: ESXiArgs aims for financial gain through ransom payments, targeting critical infrastructure sectors with VMware ESXi servers. Its regional focus on Europe suggests easier access or higher success rates there.
